cross-006.answer: ~19% (4.8 ms of the 25 ms Skiff 40 Hz frame)

cross-013.answer: Skiff runs Tern at the Performance preset, which saves 1.8 ms over Quality (2.1 ms vs 3.9 ms), per dec-run-tern-on-skiff-at-the-performance-preset--74eqayfa83ybqpe3 and fnd-tern-costs-3-9-ms-at-quality-and-2-1-ms-at-perfo--dkbskbqfgfwtryq0. I found no record tying the Meridian 120 Hz mode to Tern's lowest preset, so that part of the premise is unverified.

cross-015.answer: Two Efforts are no longer active. Shader compile cache and build farm is completed: dec-turn-the-shader-compile-cache-on-for-every-farm--4rr3b12b4sasdmaj (2026-03-20) turned the cache on for all nightly, on-demand and release farm builds, which is the end condition the Effort set. Co-op rollback netcode prototype is abandoned: dec-abandon-rollback-netcode-for-co-op--46envrg0v4pdwv7b (2026-04-01) stopped rollback because re-running tides on every rolled-back frame costs 4.8 ms on Skiff.

netcode-004.answer: The team abandoned rollback because re-running the tide simulation on every rolled-back frame costs 4.8 ms on Skiff, about a fifth of the 25 ms frame, and the workarounds failed (shrinking the window, quarter-resolution tides, leaving tides out of the snapshot). The reason depends on the world Decision dec-run-the-tide-simulation-in-32-32-fixed-point--c5rjfcnmhne4h05e.

ports-012.answer: Saltglass caustic patterns shimmered badly in motion at the 540p floor (visible in 7 of 10 dune views, versus 2 of 10 at 576p), so the team raised the floor to 576p (dec-raise-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-576p--fep9q7m08pp9f0bb, since superseded by a 504p decision).

ports-013.answer: Ship Tern as Lantern's only upscaler

render-031.answer: Alpha-tested foliage cost 2.1 ms in the visibility buffer (up from 0.8 ms in forward+), because the alpha test runs in the raster pass with a per-pixel texture fetch; saltglass cannot be in the buffer because it refracts the image behind it and needs that resolved image first. See dec-visibility-buffer-for-opaque-geometry-foliage-an--gvnvp04jgm7kbfh9, which derives from fnd-alpha-tested-foliage-costs-2-1-ms-in-the-visibil--f3g34x2k6fs367eb.

render-032.answer: Tern was made Lantern's only upscaler because Halcyon has no Skiff build, and a second upscaler would break the one-upscaler constraint; the team also wanted upscaler code it owns for saltglass refraction and caustics, with no vendor license to negotiate. See dec-ship-tern-as-lantern-s-only-upscaler--fmreq35nzyjc7k4e.

render-046.answer: Virtual shadow maps were reopened because the cost Finding that had rejected them (3.1 ms) was a capture error; with cached pages they cost 1.4 ms, less than four cascades, and cascade seams through saltglass stayed unsolved under CSM. See dec-use-virtual-shadow-maps-for-the-sun--x8nqkn9q7eaf1ap4.

render-047.answer: dec-visibility-buffer-on-all-platforms-skiff-resolve--k1ackk3c3275r5y1. Skiff returned to the visibility buffer because the release-build capture measured 7.4 ms against 8.1 ms for forward+ (6.3 ms with half-rate material resolve), so the forward+ fallback was no longer worth keeping.

world-036.answer: Kestrel retired the fiber scheduler because 41% of alpha crash reports had no usable stack (fiber workers showed only scheduler frames), which blocked crash triage for beta, while a continuation-based thread pool kept workers 93% busy versus 95% with fibers. See dec-return-engine-jobs-to-a-thread-pool-with-continu--1zkc1v2x97taf50h.
